mods.name: Player Lookup
mods.description: Client-side player lookup mod for tablist health/ping sharing.

releases.notes:
Initial release. all the features currently stated in readme.md:

## Features (all configurable)
- Track health of players in the tablist
- Track ping of players in the tablist
- Edit location and size of the tracking HUD
- Clears tracked players on join

## Keybinds (in keybinds screen)
- Toggle the tracking HUD: `Shift + L`

## Commands
- `/lookup` - Opens the config screen
- `/lookup pos` - Opens the position/scale editor screen
- `/lookup clear` - Clears tracked players

readmeSummary: A simple mod that tracks the health of select players in competitive PVP servers. It ONLY works when the Health is LISTED in the tablist!
